name: Meta Ads Manager
summary: Meta's tool for Facebook and Instagram ads.

flows.title: Find a campaign, ad set or ad
steps: Go to Ads Manager and click the Search and filter bar.
Enter a search term and choose from the predicted searches, or choose a filter from the drop-down. The arrow next to a filter category shows more.
To search only some campaigns, ad sets or ads, tick the box next to them and choose Filter by selection from the drop-down.
Choose the filters and click Apply. To keep these settings, click Save in the search bar and give them a name. Clear removes them.

flows.title: View an ad's results
steps: Go to Ads Manager and click Campaigns, Ad sets or Ads.
Hover over the campaign, ad set or ad and click View charts, which appears underneath it, to open the insights side pane.
Read the Performance, Demographics, Platform or Delivery chart. The Delivery chart is only there for reach and frequency ad sets.
To see other results in the charts, click Customise metrics in the top right-hand corner and choose the metrics. Results arrive after a short delay.

flows.title: Turn off a campaign, ad set or ad
steps: Go to Meta Ads Manager and select the Campaigns, Ad sets or Ads tab at the top of the screen.
Click the toggle next to each campaign, ad set or ad to turn off. Turning off a campaign turns off every ad set and ad in it.
A grey status means off and blue means on. Delivery can take a few minutes to stop, and turning something off does not delete it.
